description_field_semantics: The 'description' field for each tool below is the DESIGN-ARTEFACT description (carries rationale and Phase-1 evolution notes for human design readers). The LIVE REGISTERED tool description string passed to FastMCP.add_tool(...) lives in src/study_tutor/mcp/server.py and is intentionally minimal per DDR-001 — it does NOT enumerate Graphiti write side-effects, even though those side effects are present in the implementation. Do not copy the 'description' field from this JSON into server.py verbatim.

design_decisions.ADR-ARCH-017: tutor_start_session classified as 'sync' (closes prior design decision D2). Phase 1 reversion-conditional rule documented in API-mcp-transport.md §5.6.
design_decisions.ADR-ARCH-018: Cross-cutting concerns extended with CC-13 (Graphiti async at every write point) and CC-14 (runtime LLM params explicit and asserted).
design_decisions.ADR-ARCH-019: Async Graphiti write-back at every write point (broadens session-end-only ARCH-003); applies to tutor_turn (mid-session: Coach misconceptions, planner topic-confidence) and tutor_session_end (session-end episode).
design_decisions.DDR-001: MCP tool descriptions do not enumerate Graphiti write side-effects, even after CC-13 broadens fire-and-forget writes to every write point. See docs/design/decisions/DDR-001-mcp-descriptions-do-not-enumerate-graphiti-writes.md.

tools.name: tutor_start_session
tools.description: Sync. Start a tutoring session for a given subject (and optional topic). Returns a session_id immediately; an opportunistic LLM warm-up runs in the background to prime model weights. Subsequent tutor_turn calls reference the returned session_id.

subject.description: GCSE subject — free text in P0 (e.g. 'English Literature'). P1 will tighten to the Subject enum from Shared Kernel A.

topic.description: Optional topic within the subject (e.g. 'Macbeth Act 1 Scene 1'). Free text in P0; P1 will tighten to a Topic ID.

player_model.description: Optional provider override. If unset, resolves AGENT_MODELS__REASONING_MODEL at call time (SR-03). Closed set: 'local' | 'bedrock' | 'openai' | 'anthropic' | 'gemini'.

tools.name: tutor_turn
tools.description: Sync (< 30s). Generate one tutor reply for user_message within the given session. Routes through LLMClient; provider resolves from AGENT_MODELS__REASONING_MODEL at call time unless player_model is provided.

tools.name: tutor_session_status
tools.description: Sync. Read the current state of a tutoring session — status, turn count, and start time.

tools.name: tutor_session_end
tools.description: Sync. Mark a tutoring session ended. Returns within < 2s. Phase 0 flips status only; Phase 1 adds fire-and-forget persistence at every write point per CC-13 / ADR-ARCH-019, but those side effects are implementation-internal (SR-07 / DDR-001) and are not part of the user-visible contract.
